title: CycleMetadata
description: Per-suite-run global metadata emitted by the custom Playwright Reporter at onBegin and persisted to tests/e2e/web-coverage/_artifacts/cycle-metadata.json (gitignored). Authored under spec 034 cycle-1 amendment Q26 to host the deterministic cycle_start_ts that Pass 4 Q22 originally placed (loosely) on a per-gap GapRegisterEntry cell. The audit-list endpoint (FR-028, /api/audit/list?cycle=current) reads cycle_start_ts directly from bootstrap_seed_data().current_cycle_start server-side; this artefact is the symmetric suite-side surface. The web-coverage-merge job copies this file into the coverage-trace.json header so any GapRegisterEntry can reference the cycle by cycle_id rather than duplicating the timestamp. See research.md R-023 + spec.md Pass 5 Q26.

cycle_start_ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp sourced from bootstrap_seed_data().current_cycle_start (deterministic per ASM-002). MUST be byte-equal across re-runs on the same seed (SC-010).

cycle_id.description: UUID v4 generated once per suite invocation. Referenced by GapRegisterEntry.cycle_id (additive, optional) when a gap first opens during this cycle.

commit_sha.description: Full or short SHA of the HEAD commit the run was executed against.

seed_hash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the seed JSON used by bootstrap_seed_data(). Confirms the suite ran against the seed the trace assertions assume.
